name: blog-cards
title: Blog cards
description: Post cards with a cover, date, title, and summary, plus the Latest updates section.
usage: The latest posts on the home page (`BlogSection`, six at most; `allHref` adds the "All posts" pill and `hideOnPhones` hides the band below 768px, as the home page does), a blog index or a related-posts row (`BlogCards`, `tone="light"` on a white page). Pass the dot-art cover as `cover`.
avoid: Photo covers with their own colors
More than two lines of title or summary

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
